sourcePolicy: Relative paths refer to the same pinned revision as this digest-covered export. Historical references and private runs are not published ports.

verification.reason: No recorded real-import protocol bound to this subject.

terminal-colours.reason: Import from YAML applies the background, foreground, cursor and all sixteen ANSI slots to Orca's dark-mode terminal.

terminal-selection.reason: Orca's YAML import keeps no selection colours; selection stays at Orca's own default.

pane-divider.reason: Orca stores the split divider as a separate setting that a theme file cannot carry; the README gives the value to enter by hand.

terminal-font.reason: Orca keeps its own terminal font family, size and spacing settings; the theme file carries colours only.

light-mode.reason: The theme has no light profile; Orca's light-mode terminal theme is left unchanged.

outside-terminal.reason: Orca's window, sidebar and settings chrome are not themed by a terminal theme file.

files.install: Orca → Settings → Terminal Themes → Import from YAML, then select "j3w1 theme" as the Dark Theme.

ports.rollback: In Orca, open Settings → Terminal Themes, select the dark theme you used before, then remove the imported "j3w1 theme" entry. Reset Dark Divider Color if you changed it.
